fitur_khas.alasan_dipilih: Kontak publik berupa telepon tetap; pemilih pertanyaan membantu menyiapkan konfirmasi kunjungan.

q.en: How do I book an appointment?

a.id: Telepon 62283671008 untuk menanyakan prosedur pendaftaran dan ketersediaan jadwal.
a.en: Call 62283671008 to ask about registration and available appointment times.

a.id: Jl. Dr. Wahidin No.36, RT.03/RW.03, Saditan, Brebes, Jawa Tengah 52212. Konfirmasikan lokasi melalui telepon sebelum berangkat.
a.en: The practice is listed at Jl. Dr. Wahidin No.36, RT.03/RW.03, Saditan, Brebes, Central Java 52212. Call to confirm the location before travelling.

a.id: Direktori mencantumkan Senin dan Kamis 08.00–11.00 serta Selasa dan Sabtu 15.00–17.00. Hari lain tutup. Konfirmasikan jadwal melalui telepon sebelum berkunjung.
a.en: Directories list Monday and Thursday 08:00–11:00, and Tuesday and Saturday 15:00–17:00, with other days closed. Please call to confirm before visiting.

q.en: How much does an examination cost?

a.id: Harga belum tersedia. Tanyakan biaya konsultasi dan perkiraan tindakan kepada petugas; kebutuhan perawatan ditentukan setelah pemeriksaan.
a.en: Prices are not yet available. Ask staff about consultation fees and estimates. Treatment needs are determined after an examination.

q.en: Do you accept insurance or BPJS?

a.id: Kerja sama asuransi dan BPJS belum terkonfirmasi. Tanyakan ketentuan dan dokumen yang diperlukan melalui telepon.
a.en: Insurance and BPJS arrangements have not been confirmed. Call to ask about eligibility and required documents.
